methodologyNotes: Covers plug-in and hardwired electric fireplaces sold at a published US price, including wall-mount/linear units, recessable built-ins, firebox inserts, and freestanding mantel/stove units. Excludes gas, ethanol, and wood-burning fireplaces, and pure space heaters with no simulated flame. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD. mountType is an enum: wall-mount, recessed, insert, freestanding, or stove (units supporting multiple installs listed by their primary/marketed mode). widthInches is the overall front width in inches (nominal marketed size). heatCoverageSqFt is the manufacturer-rated supplemental heating area in square feet. heatOutputBtu is rated heat output in BTU per hour at high setting. maxWattage is the heater's maximum power draw in watts. voltage is the required supply in volts (120 or 240). heaterType is an enum: fan-forced, infrared-quartz, or none (display-only/no-heat models). flameColorModes is the count of distinct flame color/hue options (1 for single-color LED). heatSettings is the number of discrete heat output levels (excluding off). thermostat is a boolean for an adjustable temperature-holding thermostat. remoteControl is a boolean for an included handheld or app remote. weightPounds is unit weight in pounds. Use null for any spec the manufacturer does not disclose.
